audit.why: Both layers give Renekton levels 1-2 and hand the lane to Cassiopeia from 3 onward, which matches the 52.78% Emerald+ rate over 108 games and the kits: his whole threat is a 16s Slice and Dice into a 16s Ruthless Predator, and neither scales against a 0.75s recast. No stage side needed changing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 is described as "both ult at 6, but yours wins" on the strength of a claim about Dominus that is false, and no cooldown appears anywhere in the entry.
audit.why: Dominus is the spike that decides whether you can still stand in front of him at 6, and the entry mis-describes what it does. The numbers that make the stage readable are Cull the Meek at a flat 7s, Ruthless Predator and Slice and Dice both 16s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Dominus restated correctly and 7s / 16s written into spikes[0].text, wants.you[1] and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors and one omission. (a) mid and whys[4] call Dominus "a short-range dash slam" and "a short dash-slam". Dominus is a self-transform — range 20, no dash, no displacement — so it gives him bonus health, an aura and fury generation, and zero extra reach. A player who believes it closes distance will space wrongly at exactly the level it matters. (b) Ruthless Predator is an auto-attack reset and stuns 0.75s, doubling to 1.5s past 50 fury; neither number nor the reset is stated. (c) Cull the Meek heals him on a flat 7s cooldown and no anti-heal is ever named.
audit.why: Riot: Dominus — "Renekton transforms into the Tyrant form, gaining bonus Health and dealing damage to enemies around him". Ruthless Predator — "slashes his target twice... stuns them for 0.75 seconds. If Renekton has more than 50 Fury, he slashes three times... stunning for 1.5 seconds", flagged autoReset. Cull the Meek — "heals for a small portion of the damage dealt", 7s flat; _missing-interactions.json independently flags needs-antiheal for this matchup.
audit.corrected: Dominus corrected in mid, spikes[3].text and whys[4]; the stun durations and auto-reset tell added to spikes[0].text; Morellonomicon named in wants.you[0] and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Grievous Wounds is never mentioned even though the only thing keeping Renekton in an extended trade is Cull the Meek.
audit.why: His heal is on a 7-second cooldown and scales with fury; a Cassiopeia grinding him down with a 0.75s recast is exactly the profile that wants anti-heal on the AP item slot.
audit.corrected: Morellonomicon named in wants.you[0] and mid.

edits.before: Renekton's early all-in is brutal: empowered Q (Cull the Meek) heals him as it hits you, W (Ruthless Predator) stuns, and he can E-W-Q before you've stacked any poison. Last-hit at max range and respect it.
edits.after: Renekton's early all-in is brutal: Ruthless Predator (W) stuns 0.75s, or 1.5s past 50 fury, and it resets his auto — the wind-up is the tell, not the cast. Last-hit at max range and respect it.

edits.before: Both ult at 6, but yours wins the standoff — Petrifying Gaze stuns him as he Slices in, then you Twin-Fang him down while his fury and empowered window run dry.
edits.after: Both ult at 6, but yours wins the standoff — Dominus adds health and fury, not range, so Petrifying Gaze stuns his Slice-in and you Twin Fang him down.

edits.before: Survive his level 1-3 empowered W stun and Cull the Meek heal, then start chaining Noxious Blast into refunded Twin Fang
edits.after: Survive his 1-3 empowered W stun, then chain Noxious Blast into Twin Fang and buy Morellonomicon for the Cull the Meek heal

edits.before: Lay Miasma (W) to ground his Slice-and-Dice so he can't Dice back out after engaging you
edits.after: Lay Miasma (W) to ground Slice and Dice so he cannot Dice out — 16s before he tries again

edits.before: Both ult at 6, but Petrifying Gaze stuns him as he Slices in and his R is only a short dash-slam, so you answer his last all-in and shred him.
edits.after: Both ult at 6, but Petrifying Gaze stuns him as he Slices in and Dominus is a transform with no extra range, so you answer his last all-in and shred him.

edits.before: This is where you take over. With ranks in Q and E you chain Twin Fangs faster than his Cull the Meek can heal, and his fury combo is gated on regenerating fury between rotations — bait the W stun, then ground him on Miasma and DPS him down while he can't Slice or Dice. Serpentine Grace means he physically cannot stick to you between his dashes. At 6 his R is his only real re-engage, but it's a short-range dash slam, not a gap-closer — your Petrifying Gaze stuns him as he commits, and even empowered he burns through fury and falls off while your poison keeps ramping.
edits.after: This is where you take over. With ranks in Q and E you chain Twin Fang faster than his 7s Cull the Meek can heal, and Morellonomicon makes sure it cannot — bait the W stun, then ground him on Miasma and DPS him down while Slice and Dice sits on its 16s wait. Serpentine Grace means he cannot stick to you between dashes. At 6 Dominus is a transform, not a gap-close: it buys him health and fury but no extra range, so Petrifying Gaze still stuns him as he Slices in, and he burns fury faster than he regenerates it while your poison keeps ramping.

notes: _missing-interactions.json flags "Renekton's Ruthless Predator (W) absorbs your burst window" under the shield-absorbs-burst rule. That is a tooltip-parsing misfire: the shield word in Riot's text is that empowered Ruthless Predator DESTROYS damage shields on the target. Renekton gains no shield and Cassiopeia has none to lose, so I wrote nothing about it. The remaining "Twin Fangs" plural in this entry is inside mid, which this proposal replaces.
